schema.description: For say, capability, receipt, and trace, surface is required. surface=thread requires thread_id; the first valid send creates the public thread. surface=direct requires an existing direct_id. capability, receipt, and trace also require work_id. capability and lifecycle-bearing say also require to. greet and whois omit conversation and work fields.

body.description: Kind-specific object. say requires a non-empty text field; other kinds follow the AGH Network message body rules.

direct_id.description: Required with surface=direct. Resolve the existing room before sending.

surface.description: Required for say, capability, receipt, and trace; omitted for greet and whois.

thread_id.description: Required with surface=thread. Use a fresh valid ID. The first valid send creates the public thread; later sends reuse the same ID.

to.description: Target peer. Required for capability and for say carrying work_id.

work_id.description: Required for capability, receipt, and trace; optional for lifecycle-bearing say messages.
